notes: Sony's 2012-09-19 release. Sony labels the third axis 'length' (width × height × length); it is recorded as depth, the front-to-back axis of a console standing on its feet. Excluding the maximum projecting part. Mass 2.1 kg for the HDD models; footnote *6: 'PS3 with flash memory 12GB weights approximately 2.0kg' (CECH-4000A), a different SKU in the same body, so not a conflict.

ports = the release's Inputs/Outputs, Networking and AV output rows. Sony's table says 'USB' without naming the receptacle; it is filed as usb_a, the only USB receptacle in the §3 vocabulary before USB-C, and the reader should treat the A as Sony-unstated. Sony's input/output row does not list the AC inlet, so ports has no power_in item; that absence is Sony's table, not a statement that the console has no inlet. features.power_inlet stays null.
media: the release says the model adopts a sliding disk cover (top-loading), filed as one disc_lid. A vertical stand (CECH-ZST1) is sold separately.
released = the first NA date (250 GB); Europe 2012-09-28, Japan 2012-10-04. external_ids: Wikidata Q89930790 ('PlayStation 3 Super Slim').
